responsibility: Provides the generic out-of-order scalar scheduling model for RISC-V cores. It declares DFA automata, issue and execution resources, and instruction reservations for integer, floating-point, branch, load/store, multiply/divide, popcount/clmul, and transfer operations under the `generic_ooo` tune, giving the scheduler a baseline latency and throughput model for out-of-order processors distinct from vector scheduling and vendor-specific cores.
